A service partner built on reliability

Fusion Engineers and Technocrats LLP looks after generators and diesel engines for factories, commercial buildings and infrastructure sites in Navi Mumbai, Thane and across Maharashtra. For more than seven years, businesses have called us when power cannot fail.

Our technicians combine hands-on field experience with genuine parts and clear, honest quotes. Whether it is one silent generator repair or a multi-site maintenance contract, we treat your machine like our own.

  • Experienced technicians
  • Transparent pricing
  • Focused on B2B clients
  • Support across Maharashtra

Repair and maintenance services

Fixes that last and maintenance that prevents the next breakdown.

Silent generator repair

Diagnosis and repair of canopy DG sets: alternator faults, cooling problems, enclosure fixes and complete overhauls, done with minimal turnaround.

Diesel engine maintenance

Preventive servicing, oil and filter changes, valve and injector checks, top overhauls and engine rebuilds that protect performance and fuel economy.

Generator set AMCs

Annual Maintenance Contracts with scheduled visits, priority breakdown response, written service reports and predictable yearly costs.

Also part of our service range

  • Engine overhauling as per OEM shop manual
  • Breakdown calls and scheduled maintenance
  • Special AMC packages for fire engines
  • AMC packages by industry and operating schedule
  • Radiator servicing, repair and new supply
  • Spares for all leading makes
  • New DG sets and application engines

How a service call works

  1. Step 1

    Tell us the problem

    An optional AMC keeps your equipment serviced all year.

Common questions

What does a generator AMC include?

Scheduled preventive visits, routine servicing, priority breakdown attendance and a service report after each visit. Cover is tailored to your capacity and site.

Which areas do you cover?

We are based in Navi Mumbai and Thane and support clients across the Mumbai region and Maharashtra.

Can I buy spares without a service contract?

Yes. Share your engine or controller model and we will confirm compatibility and price.

How fast can an engineer reach my site?

It depends on your location. Breakdown calls are prioritised, and AMC customers get priority attendance.

Generator down? Tell us what you need.
